name: Chan Chun Shing
tagline: I make pictures and moving images about ordinary Hong Kong — alleys, shopfronts, and the people passing through them.
about: I'm a digital media student at HKDI (Hong Kong Design Institute), working across photography, video editing, motion design and visual effects.

Most of my personal work starts on the street. I like the unplanned frame — a 7-Eleven at 2am, someone waiting at a bus stop — and I try to keep that documentary instinct when I'm editing or compositing.
I'm comfortable end to end: shooting, cutting in Premiere, building motion in After Effects, and cleaning it up with generative tools when the shot calls for it.
